# Realistic women fixture set

These six synthetic photorealistic PNGs provide a second visual cohort for UI and manual computer-vision testing:

- `arms_01.png`, `arms_02.png`: two separate women's arm/forearm images
- `arm_coin_01.png`, `arm_coin_02.png`: one women's arm plus a visible 1 EUR coin
- `leg_coin_01.png`, `leg_coin_02.png`: one women's leg plus a visible 1 EUR coin

They are generated test assets, not photographs of real people and not clinical ground truth. They are kept separate from the existing realistic and deterministic fixture cohorts.
